buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses a .BIDDERS TO COMPLY ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS ALONG WITH THE SCOPE OF WORK AS UPLOAD ED IN BID ATC. b. Inspection After Repair: After completion of the repair work, the vehicle shall be inspected and tested by the User Department at t he User's premises to verify that all repairs have been carried out satisfactorily and the equipment is funct ioning properly. c. Acceptance After Successful Inspection: The repaired vehicle shall be considered accepted only after successful inspection and functional testing b y the User Department and issuance of satisfactory acceptance/inspection confirmation by the authorized representative of the User Department. d. Rectification of Defects: If any defect, deficiency, or non-compliance with the tender specifications is observed during inspection or testing, the contractor shall rectify the same at no additional cost to the Buyer within the time specified by the Buyer. e. No Payment Before Acceptance: Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory completion of the repair work, successful inspection an d testing by the User Department, and submission of the required documents, subject to the applicable Ge M payment terms. f. Responsibility for Quality of Repair: The contractor shall be fully responsible for the quality and workmanship of the repair work and for ensurin g that the forklift operates safely and satisfactorily after repair. g. Inspection and Testing at User Premises: All post-repair inspection and functional testing shall be carried out at the User Department's premises. Th e contractor shall arrange the necessary technical personnel, tools, and support required for the inspectio n and testing without any additional cost, unless otherwise specified in the contract. h. Warranty for Repair Work:

The contractor shall provide a warranty of 06 months from the date of satisfactory acceptance of the repai red forklift. Any defect arising due to defective workmanship or faulty parts during the warranty period sha ll be rectified by the contractor at no additional cost, subject to the warranty terms specified in the contra ct. i. Completion of Repair Within the Stipulated Period: The contractor shall complete the repair work within the delivery/completion period specified in the GeM c ontract. Any delay shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable contract terms and conditions. j. Handover of vehicle : After successful inspection and acceptance, the contractor shall hand over the forklift to the User Departm ent in proper working condition, along with details of repairs carried out and parts replaced, wherever appl icable. k.repair work will be carried out at buyer premises under supervision of buyer rep. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.
